title: Revision impact selection
responsibility: Chooses recorded or source-derived impact and falls back to active-registry dependency comparison.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision, or undefined when no base is selected.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.head
inputs.description: Later revision containing recorded comparison and source impact.

inputs.name: harnessImpact.compared
inputs.description: Optional precomputed source-side comparison, used only when its commit pair matches.

inputs.name: comparedSides.client
inputs.description: Client able to load stored source sides.

inputs.name: comparedSides.base
inputs.description: Earlier revision naming its stored side.

inputs.name: comparedSides.head
inputs.description: Later revision naming its stored side.

outputs.name: harnessImpact
outputs.description: Impact groups, scenarios, uncertainty and marks. Prefers a record comparing the exact base, then matching source impact, then version changes and transitive consumers across both active registries. Marks prioritize removed over added, direct and indirect.

outputs.name: comparedSides
outputs.description: Loads both stored sides and delegates their comparison, returning the commit pair and impact; undefined if either side reference is absent.
